dataset_id = 'f9cad7b01a472135c14fd448f4d7b655'

# Download the ZIP

    tmp_path = tmp.name

gi.datasets.download_dataset(dataset_id, file_path=tmp_path, use_default_filename=False)
print(f'Downloaded to: {tmp_path}')

# Extract specific file
target = '156083at2759.faa.mafft.clipkit.treefile'

    if names:
        zf.extract(names[0], '/workspace/')
        print(f'Extracted: {names[0]} -> /workspace/{names[0]}')

os.unlink(tmp_path)
"
